verdict.rationale: The only evidence on this story is the sandbox docs, which list a 'statement generation' simulation endpoint. That implies Unit's own platform generates account statements, but per-account monthly cadence and API retrieval are not documented, and tax documents (1099-INT) are never mentioned. missing for 10: documented monthly per-account statement generation and retrieval API, 1099-INT tax document production and API retrieval, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, the paper obligations are automated — monthly statements generated per account, and tax documents (1099-INT) produced and retrievable through the API
